subject.title: fix(workboard): decomposed children no longer block aggregate parents

question: Should Workboard formally adopt non-blocking orchestration as the default decomposition contract, with explicit hard mode and an opt-in Doctor repair for existing reciprocal links?
rationale: This is a behavioral and persisted-contract choice affecting existing operators and future gateway/tool consumers; source review can verify implementation mechanics but cannot choose the desired compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve orchestration as the default
options.body: Accept the new default, explicit hard mode, Doctor migration, and repair operations as the supported Workboard contract.

options.title: Preserve blocking decomposition by default
options.body: Keep current reciprocal dependency semantics as the default and redesign the non-blocking behavior as an explicit opt-in workflow.

options.title: Narrow the public repair API
options.body: Keep the migration direction but remove or defer the new gateway and agent-tool repair commands until their long-term API contract is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Approve orchestration as the default
recommendation.body: Accept the new default, explicit hard mode, Doctor migration, and repair operations as the supported Workboard contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the only concrete person connected to the current Workboard implementation, though maintainer sponsorship is still required.
